# Country scope (CHI). Safe increment of completed Pingzhunku monetary audits.
oe_yr2_inc_audit_count = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_yr2_audit_count }
        change_variable = { name = oe_yr2_audit_count add = 1 }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = oe_yr2_audit_count value = 1 }
    }
}
